name: Food effect on AUC (fold-change)
definition: Fold-change in AUC due to food effect on oral absorption, as reported in clinical pharmacology studies or labels. A value of 1 indicates no food effect; values greater than 1 indicate increased exposure with food.

name: Molecular weight (Da)
definition: Molecular weight of the compound in Daltons (g/mol), computed from structure by the curated descriptor route rather than a trained prediction; lower values are preferred because size above roughly 500 Da approaches the upper limit compatible with efficient passive intestinal diffusion and increases efflux-transporter recognition.

name: Oral bioavailability (human, measured F%)
definition: Reported absolute or relative oral bioavailability (F%) in humans, as a measured pharmacokinetic parameter. Higher values indicate greater fraction of an orally administered dose reaching systemic circulation intact. This is a preference ordering, not a requirement: low F% compounds may still be clinically effective if the dose can be escalated.

name: Predicted aqueous solubility (log mol/L)
definition: Model-predicted aqueous solubility in log(mol/L) from the ADMET-AI Solubility_AqSolDB model; recorded as a descriptive consideration because the cited claims report solubility as a generic drug-like property and give low-solubility examples, without validating this endpoint or establishing a direction for this library.

name: Predicted blood-brain barrier penetration probability (BBB_Martins)
definition: Model-predicted probability of blood-brain barrier penetration; lower probability is generally preferred for peripheral targets to minimise CNS side effects.

name: Predicted BRENK alert count
definition: Number of BRENK alerts from RDKit; higher counts indicate greater likelihood of problematic substructures.

name: Predicted Caco-2 permeability (ADMET-AI Caco2_Wang, log 10^-6 cm/s)

name: Predicted clinical toxicity probability (exploratory)

Recorded as an exploratory consideration only: the cited evidence documents general toxicity and dose-limiting adverse events for this drug class but no cited claim validates this model or states a probability threshold. Where several predicted values are available for a compound, the worst-case (maximum) value is recorded.

name: Predicted CYP1A2 inhibition probability
definition: Model-predicted probability that the compound inhibits CYP1A2, in [0,1]; higher values indicate greater drug-drug interaction liability.
